## Set up 

```{r}
#| label: call packages


library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(ggdist)
library(tidybayes)
library(posterior)
```

```{r}
#| label: call data

Exp1 <- read.table("QML-Final-Project/data/Form-Based_FinalProj/Exp1.txt")
Exp2 <- read.table("QML-Final-Project/data/Form-Based_FinalProj/Exp2.txt")

#I've called Experiment 1 but current code only deals with Experiment 2

#changing default column names to match variables
colnames(Exp2) <- c("Subject", "Item", "WordType", "Rating", "Accuracy", "Confusion")


# Filter out "NA" lines and remove any items where subject misspelled the word, following Haslett and Cai's methodology
Exp2_filt <- Exp2 |>
  na.omit(Exp2) |>
  filter(Accuracy == "1", Confusion == "0") |>
  mutate(WordType = factor(WordType, levels = c("attractor", "target", "control")))
  #Changed the WordType column to a factor so that order in charts will match that presented by the original paper
```

## Initial Initial Bits

```{r}
#| label: bar charts

#Two bar charts to show initial Exp2 results - they show the same thing, was just playing around with different presentations

Exp2_filt|>
  ggplot(aes(WordType, fill = factor(Rating))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") + 
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") 

Exp2_filt |>
  ggplot(aes(Rating)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(WordType))
```
